decisions.text: type bar: categories compared by value
clustered bars: 6 series of one measure across categories (G1.56, R9-12)
nominal categories sorted by value, descending (by series south)

6 series side by side in each cluster, the bars touching, in the same order in every cluster: South (slot 1), North (slot 2), Central (slot 3), West (slot 4), East (slot 5), Int'l (slot 6) (G7.5, G4.22)
every name fits under its bar, neighbours at least 10 pt apart: vertical bars
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$100K in donations”
the unit phrase on the top label: “$100K in donations”; the top gridline starts after it
a legend above the plot, below the title, centred over the plot: labels beside the bars of a cluster would each need a leader (G5.7, G5.10, D-7)
legend entries in the order of the bars in each cluster, left to right: South, North, Central, West, East, Int'l (G5.8, G5.14: square keys)

source.shows: the book's flat 2-D version of a 3-D chart (a 3-D chart cannot be asked for): six series per cluster, the clusters kept about two bar widths apart as the book's are (G7.5s), the legend in the order of the bars; the methods sorted by the first series (D-46)
